newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down on profit-taking.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended down on Wednesday as profit-taking by small investors wiped out early gains made on broad-based buying. Dealers said they expected the index to slip further on a technical correction.

"A technical correction is due because the index had shot sharply up in a short span," said dealer Hina Akhlaq of KASB & Co. "Sentiment is positive, but the index may fall 100 to 150 points gradually on a technical correction."
The index fell 5.84 points, or 0.33 percent, to end at 1,756.77. Gainers led losers 228 to 111. Dewan Textile fell 10 to 210 and PTCL 0.15 to 34.20. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
